en: Black‑and‑white view along a calm river or wide stream bordered by forest. On the right bank stands a partly ruined masonry building attached to a more intact house with a pitched roof and simple windows. A dirt path runs beside the house. In the mid‑distance on the left bank, partly hidden by trees, is a romantic villa or small castle‑like house with a pointed turret and timber‑frame details, built directly above the water. The scene is rural and tranquil, with no people or text visible on the image itself.
